title: LLV-GRF320-BANK-LOG: logarithmically smaller counted quantum backing allocation

claims.statement: For every N>=2 and s in Z/NZ, n=ceil(log2N), the ONE PHYSICAL LLV-GRF320-BANK-LOG interpreter in proof.md executes the exact complete virtual LLV-GRF320 program in virtual.md. Its main branch n>=2^4096 uses the original centered period-six fan-in rule, exact integer parameters, one variable-output finishing call, Dbar,Dcap,Ccap,Qcap, fixed FIND schedule and complete all-modulus decoder; its explicit finite branch is unchanged. Unconditional entire-secret success is at least1-2^-8. On EVERY branch, including all failures, discarded copies, wrong labels, source/leaf aborts, initialization and cleanup, charged time is O(2^((1/2)sqrt(n)log2n)), exact index1/2. The strict internal487/51200sqrt(n) margin in the full weighted virtual ledger pays the separately charged polynomial interpreter. All outside constants are absolute and all four resources hold jointly for this SAME configuration under independent ideal source copies and clean fraction0. Physical layout t=n+2,ell=bit_length(n-1),d=max(1,ell),lambda_bank=ceil(6ell/5),E=2^lambda_bank,A=2^16t,W=ceil(2^128t^2E/d),H=2^32t reserves all seven padded basis regions and the ENTIRE paired prefix. Every metadata/address/source-move/measurement/reset/generator cost is counted. All large classical records are basis-bank qubits; only fixed staged words and input/output remain classical. Original virtual memory declarations are not substituted for physical allocation. The ACTUAL padded bank is smaller by d: Mtab=ceil(8t/d), four current Mlist=ceil(256tE/d) arrays and four Mres=ceil(8tE/d) arrays, with all other scratch, frames and ownership fitting the separately proved capacities. This is not a smaller bound on the old larger allocation.
